paper_metadata.title: Use of tungsten single crystals to enhance nuclear reactors structural elements properties

evidence.quote: The results of comparative studies of the mechanical properties of polycrystalline and monocrystalline tungsten e 4% tantalum alloy are presented.
Single-crystal WeTa samples were cut along the <110> direction with an inclination angle less than 4 /C14 , the working part of the plane is close to the {111} with a deviation less than 4 /C14 .
